entries.label: Officers’ Feast
entries.prompt: Create a BRAND NEW composition, not an edit of any previous painting. One original opaque full-bleed medieval dark-fantasy gamepiece painting. Narrative composition of N.C.Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action/building, bold silhouettes, grouped figures subordinate to architecture, strong purposeful diagonal, broad calm masses, ONE focal light/contrast. Hand-placed PIXEL CLUSTERS, hard edges, selective dithering, restricted palette; not smooth 3D, oil-photo detail or high-frequency noise. All human, dead and depicted faces ENTIRELY INDISCERNIBLE at FULL SIZE: backs, opaque hood voids, fully closed helmets, tiny distant shapes; no eyes/nose/mouth, readable skull faces or portrait statues. Violence implied through institutional ritual, shrouds and coercion, non-graphic, no gore, wounds or exposed organs. No text, readable writing, UI, frames, borders, vignettes, logos or decorative emblem overlay. One relevant worn diegetic cult mark is allowed because requested; no unrelated symbols. Clarity at70x100 pixels. PRACTICE CANVAS5:7 PORTRAIT. DESIGN FROM THE OVERLAY UP: the ENTIRE principal action, all2-3 people, hands, identifying tool and material fit x25-75%, y8-38%; every foot/object ends ABOVE y40%. Floor/work ledge at y36-38%; heads at y22-26%, nobody taller than14%canvas. Enlarge environment, not actors. Lower55% y45-100% is ONE broad near-black quiet foreground wall, floor or recessed void, NO people, tools, bright debris, banners, reflections, paths, flames or second focal feature. No tall foreground figures. Do not put people at the vertical centre or floor at50%. Architecture surrounds upper action; outer top-right is quiet for Stock fitting. VALUE HIERARCHY IS CRITICAL: reduce scene to THREE broad value groups. Deep quiet dark field, a single middle-value architectural silhouette, and a SMALL connected light cluster on the action/entrance. At least70% of the image is dark quiet mass, about25% is middle-value structural mass, at most5% is a connected small light patch at the focal action. Sparse restrained edge highlights near focal point, never glittery all-over masonry, glowing skies, scattered candles, sharp foreground rubble or multiple equal-bright objects. Texture stays subordinate and grouped, colour accents are not new light sources. CLASS PALETTE: Vermilion/brick red PRIMARY and oxidized teal ACCENT, dark iron plum shadows. Red cloth and teal iron remain distinct; no orange sky or all-over warm tint. PATRON GRAMMAR: Unbending Crown: three rigid upright spear-prongs bound by ONE closed transverse band. Ordered, brutally symmetrical, carapace-like state equipment; obedience turns the civilisation into an empty armoured body. Not a face, eye or generic tentacle. MATURITY: CAPITAL: the useful institution is an inhuman god-body disguised as machinery or architecture, swollen, binding, parasitic or rigid according to its patron. Clear grand silhouette, broken side courts, depleted human scale, shrouded remains only when relevant. Developed oppressive cosmic horror, not merely a luxurious palace and not a monster battle. SUBJECT: Three fully helmeted officers in rich but fraying red cloaks sit around an excessive banquet table in a cavernous decayed military hall. Interpret obsolete palette words in the subject using the CLASS PALETTE above. Keep the card’s institution and function recognisable. No new population sacrifice is implied for a card whose original subject does not consume people. IMPORTANT FINAL DIRECTION: No large painted/carved patron logo or crest on a facade. For frontier use at most one tiny worn mark, no giant emblem. For province/capital the patron must alter the physical outline of the functional object/building: an enclosing grasping hook, living folded book-spine, empty parasitic solar opening or armoured three-prong carapace. NOT a conventional palace with a logo stuck on it. Omit tiny decorative masonry marks; dark architecture has broad connected faces with sparse texture, never every edge picked in gold. Sky stays darker than the focal light, no white sky windows, bright snow field or foreground reflection. For a Practice no cloth, platform or prop hangs below40%height. Entire action ends by40%, LOWER60% is subdued almost-black negative space, no detailed highlighted foreground piers. Fresh asymmetrical viewpoint where appropriate, avoid repeating the same front-facing arch in every card. All human faces remain opaque unresolvable voids.
